messages:
Elena (People Ops): Welcome Tom! Quick checklist before Mon day‑1: I-9 completion, BG check follow-up, laptop delivery, benefits enrollment, and buddy intro. @raj can you confirm laptop ship ETA? @lisa please share benefits link.

raj (IT): Laptop reserved — Dell XPS 13 dev config. Shipping label created, ETA Wed 4pm PST. Tracking: https://courier.example/track/ABCD1234

it-ops-bot: Device policy acceptance outstanding for tom.h — automated reminder sent.

tom.h (New Hire): Thanks — I'll be remote. Can I do the I-9 verification via authorized agent? I have my passport.

Elena (People Ops): Yes — for remote hires we use an authorized agent workflow. I filed the remote I-9 exception with our HR partner. Please scan passport + driver's license (if available) and upload to the secure intake link below. Also fill the short agent form so we can complete Section 2.
https://redwoodhr.okta.com/i9-remote

michelle (Hiring Manager): FYI I attached the onboarding schedule to the calendar invite. 9:00am intro, 10:30 role walkthrough, 2:00 security training.

lisa (Benefits): Benefits portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/enroll — enroll within 30 days to keep dependents/backdating options. I'll DM you the summary for medical/dental/401k.

Elena (People Ops): Vendor flagged background check: "address discrepancy". Vendor emailed tom.h requesting proof of prior address. Tom, please reply with the lease/utility doc or notify me if you need help.

tom.h (New Hire): I just replied to their email and uploaded a signed lease. Let me know if they need anything else.

raj (IT): IT note for remote verification: we also need a quick selfie with gov ID for our asset provisioning records. Please upload to the secure intake form here (expires in 72h): https://secure.redwood.com/onboard-upload

michelle (Hiring Manager): One more thing — who will be Tom's mentor/buddy? @marta volunteered during hiring sync.

marta (Buddy): Happy to be buddy. I'll introduce myself on Day 1 and schedule a 30‑min coffee chat next week. :wave:

Elena (People Ops): Great — adding Marta to the calendar and creating #welcome-tom Slack channel. Tom, last administrative steps: payroll/direct deposit + tax forms here: https://payroll.redwood.com/setup (complete before first paycheck).

payroll-bot: Payroll profile created for tom.h — pending direct deposit details. Reminder sent.

it-ops-bot: Access request created for tom.h: GitHub (developer), AWS dev account. Approvals pending from michelle.

michelle (Hiring Manager): Approved GitHub + AWS access.

raj (IT): Provisioning started for accounts and VPN. ETA ~2 hours, will post creds to 1Password and ping Tom.

Elena (People Ops): Thanks everyone — tracking these items: I-9 remote workflow, BG vendor resolved, laptop shipping, benefits link sent, buddy assigned. :thumbsup:
